cards.text: Friend, the workers just finished the tabernacle's curtains, frames and furniture. Now they put down the hammers and pick up the needles. Out of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, they make specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary.

cards.question: Along with the garments for ministry, they make the holy garments for ___.
True or false: the workers design these holy garments however they think looks best.

cards.text: Right, friend. They make them "just as the LORD had commanded Moses." That's Moses, Israel's leader, and keep your ears open for that line.

Bezalel, the craftsman from the tribe of Judah, makes the ephod from finely spun linen with blue, purple and scarlet yarn. And he works GOLD into it, friend, and the fanciest thing I ever wore was a flour stain.

cards.question: Gold is metal, and the ephod is cloth. How do they get the gold into the weave?

answers.text: They hammer it thin and cut threads
They melt it and pour it on
They grind it and dye with it

cards.text: Shoulder pieces get attached at two of the ephod's corners so it can be fastened on. Then comes a skillfully woven waistband.

cards.question: True or false: the ephod's waistband is woven as one piece with the ephod.

cards.text: Next, onyx stones go into gold filigree settings. Each one gets engraved like a seal.

cards.question: What's engraved on the onyx stones for the ephod?

answers.text: The names of the sons of Israel
The words of the Ten Commandments
The names of Moses and Aaron

cards.question: The onyx stones go on the ephod's shoulder pieces as ___ stones for the sons of Israel.

cards.text: Then comes the breastpiece, made with gold, blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. Folded double, it's a square, a span long and a span wide.

cards.question: True or false: the breastpiece is made with the same workmanship as the ephod.

cards.text: On the breastpiece go four rows of gemstones, three to a row, from a ruby, a topaz and an emerald in the first row down to a beryl, an onyx and a jasper in the fourth. Twelve stones, all set in gold filigree, and friend, I can't even get sprinkles to sit in a straight line.

cards.question: Each of the twelve stones on the breastpiece is engraved like a seal. With what?

answers.text: The name of one of the tribes

cards.text: To hold the breastpiece in place, they make braided chains of pure gold and a set of gold rings. The chains run up to the ephod's shoulder pieces, and more rings go on the breastpiece's other corners and on the front of the ephod, just above the waistband.

cards.question: Last step: they tie the breastpiece's rings to the ephod's rings with a cord of blue yarn. Why?

answers.text: So it won't swing out from the ephod
So it can come off in a hurry
So the stones won't scratch the linen

cards.text: And there's that line again: "just as the LORD had commanded Moses." They follow the plan to the letter, and I respect it, because the one time I winged a batch, the smoke alarm gave me a STANDING OVATION.
Next up is the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver. And the whole thing is one single color.

cards.question: The robe of the ephod is woven entirely of ___ cloth.
The robe has an opening in the center, with a collar around it. What's the collar for?

answers.text: So it sits higher on the neck
So it can be tied shut

cards.text: Down at the lower hem, they make pomegranates out of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen. And between them goes something of pure gold that you'd hear coming.

cards.question: Between the yarn pomegranates on the hem, they hang ___ of pure gold.

cards.text: Bell, pomegranate, bell, pomegranate, all the way around the hem, and somewhere Mags is SO proud. Then come the linen pieces: tunics, a turban, ornate headbands, undergarments and a sash embroidered with blue, purple and scarlet yarn.

cards.question: True or false: the linen tunics are made for Aaron alone.

cards.text: Then the finishing touch: a plate of pure gold for the holy crown. They engrave it like an inscription on a seal.

cards.question: What words are engraved on the gold plate of the holy crown?
They fasten a blue cord to the gold plate to mount it on the ___.
True or false: once the holy crown is made, all the work for the tabernacle is complete.

cards.text: DONE. Every frame, every curtain, every gold bell, finished, and friend, I can't even finish a batch without eating half the dough.

Then they bring it all to Moses: the tent and its frames, the ark and the mercy seat, the table with the Bread of the Presence, the lampstand, both altars, the courtyard curtains, right down to the tent pegs and the priests' garments.
The Israelites have done all the work, and Moses inspects ALL of it. Friend, if somebody inspected all MY work, I'd be hiding behind the oven.

cards.question: Moses sees they did it all just as the LORD had commanded. So what does Moses do?

answers.text: He gives them a day off

cards.text: Every piece is made, checked and blessed. We'll pause right here, friend, because this story isn't over yet.
